name: cpu_usage_ratio
description: Fraction of CPU time not idle, averaged across all servers.

name: cpu_load_ratio
description: CPU load average across all servers, normalised by CPU count. Can exceed 1.0 when the run queue is longer than the CPU count.

name: memory_usage_ratio
description: Fraction of total used memory, averaged across all servers.

name: network_in_bytes
description: Sum of incoming network throughput across all interfaces of all servers (S3 traffic, inter-node traffic, monitoring, ...).

name: network_out_bytes
description: Sum of outgoing network throughput across all interfaces of all servers (S3 traffic, inter-node traffic, monitoring, ...).

name: objects_count
description: Number of objects stored on the RING, including replicas.

name: objects_unique_count
description: Number of unique (logical) objects stored on the RING, regardless of replica count.

name: objects_missing_count
description: Number of objects with missing or out-of-service chunks.

name: capacity_disk_unique_tb
description: Total stored data of unique objects before replication (logical data size).

name: capacity_disk_stored_tb
description: Total stored data including replicas.

name: capacity_disk_used_tb
description: Total disk space actually consumed, including overheads beyond stored object sizes.

name: capacity_disk_available_tb
description: Total free disk space on the RING.

name: capacity_disk_total_tb
description: Total physical disk capacity. Static unless disks are removed from the RING.

name: disk_read_bytes
description: Total disk read throughput summed across all disks.

name: disk_write_bytes
description: Total disk write throughput summed across all disks.

name: disk_io_time_seconds
description: Fraction of time spent on I/O averaged across all disks. 1.0 means fully saturated.

name: disk_errors_count
description: Overall error count across all disks.

name: s3_errors_5xx
description: Rate of HTTP 5xx server errors across all S3 services.

name: s3_request_get_operations
description: GET request rate.

name: s3_request_post_operations
description: POST request rate (near constant: the nominal workload does not use multipart uploads).

name: s3_request_put_operations
description: PUT request rate.

name: s3_request_delete_operations
description: DELETE request rate.

name: s3_request_head_operations
description: HEAD request rate (metadata lookups).

name: s3_throughput_in_bytes
description: Client-to-S3 data rate.

name: s3_throughput_out_bytes
description: S3-to-client data rate (dominates throughput_in in the GET-heavy workload).

name: s3_request_get_latency
description: 95th percentile GET request duration.

name: s3_request_post_latency
description: 95th percentile POST request duration. Near constant in the nominal workload.

name: s3_request_put_latency
description: 95th percentile PUT request duration.

name: s3_request_delete_latency
description: 95th percentile DELETE request duration.

name: s3_request_head_latency
description: 95th percentile HEAD request duration.
